This baseline records accepted interim risk and is not evidence the findings are fixed.

Nox currently emits this same fingerprint for the pinned Node builder, Go builder, and runtime FROM lines; keep three records because baseline matching is occurrence-counted. The runtime installs zlib>=1.4-r0 before the image is used. Remove this occurrence when a new scan confirms its base image no longer reports zlib 1.3.2-r1.

ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 affects zlib 1.3.2-r1 embedded in node:22.23.5-alpine3.24@sha256:1314fb30ec37592d5845e5a160d522c0e680972aa534549940b8d73bde88481a. Alpine v3.24 has not published fixed zlib 1.4-r0 yet. The Dockerfile installs zlib>=1.4-r0 and fails the build if unavailable; Nox inventories the FROM image rather than the post-install image. Remove when the base digest includes fixed zlib.
